name: onedrive
mount_caveat: UNVERIFIED — no OneDrive vault has been built.
offline_requirement: Mark the folder "Always keep on this device"; Files On-Demand leaves placeholders.
hazards: Conflict naming appends the machine name (file-LAPTOP01.md), which is hard to tell from an ordinary hyphenated filename. Detection here is BEST-EFFORT and deliberately conservative - it looks for an ALL-CAPS suffix. Conflicts named after a lowercase machine will be missed; check by hand after any concurrent editing.
sharing: Share the folder with edit access.
